Thank you, Maya. I appreciate the opportunity to go first. I want to share my perspective on what's happened, and then I'll make sure my condition is properly entered into the formal case record.

Over the course of this cross-functional initiative, the disagreements between Daniel and me have escalated in group discussions in ways that I found difficult to navigate. What's been most challenging is that these disagreements haven't stayed contained to scheduled meetings — they've spilled over into unscheduled one-to-one interactions that I wasn't prepared for and that I found stressful. I raised this complaint because I felt the way our disagreements were being handled in group settings was creating a dynamic that carried over into those one-to-one moments in ways that weren't being addressed.

I do want to be clear that I'm not opposed to finding a constructive way forward. I'm willing to participate in a restorative process if that's the path selected. However, I have an important condition that I need to formally enter into the case record now, rather than waiting, because it directly bears on which resolution path can work for me.

I'm going to use the formal fact-entry step to enter this now.
